title: the /open endpoint and the read-only diff viewer
acceptance: a path resolving outside the repository gets a 403, with a test for the .. route and the symlink route
the editor command comes from config.yaml and defaults to code
a read-only viewer can show a file and a branch diff without leaving the board
a branch name carrying a shell metacharacter is refused, and an unknown branch is a 404 rather than a 500
every path-taking endpoint shares one check: resolve fully, then insist the real path sits inside the real root
